data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"Tests constrain their subject only when they are part of an installation registry that records fail-first authority, and the 3-of-26 distribution is a registry-size effect: compile.py has at most one shown-to-fail-first entry in the registry (1/9), while each ordinarily-guarded module has a fuller registry entry (4/4 to 6/7), making the loss rate a function of how many mutations fall under an installed guard.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If the registry contains entries for compile.py mutations that were not evaluated before installation, the 1/9 rate would not be a registry-size effect.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If a module with 6/7 loss has only one registry entry, the coverage-proportionality mechanism would fail.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the registry is not actually consulted during mutation evaluation (e.g., guards are checked statically instead), the registry mechanism would be irrelevant.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the 3-of-26 result is produced by a tool that does not use a registry at all, the claim would be overturned.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The registry is the mechanism: a test constrains a subject if and only if the registry contains an installed guard entry for that subject with shown-to-fail-first status. The compile.py 1/9 rate reflects that only one of its nine mutations falls under a registry entry installed before mutation evaluation. The 4/4 to 6/7 rates in ordinarily-guarded modules reflect that nearly all mutations in those modules fall under registry entries installed fail-first. The condition is therefore: the test constrains its subject when the mutation path intersects a registry entry whose installation preceded the mutation evaluation, and the magnitude of constraint is proportional to registry coverage.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
